title.es: El de la arena de la playa
title.en: The One With the Sand From the Beach

description.es: Marta ha hecho traer arena de la playa para Jaime y se la da. A Jaime le viene a la memoria una historia que Marta escribió para él tiempo atrás. Mientras Marta intenta volver a escribir esa historia, Fina va a su habitación y hablan sobre Jaime.
description.en: Marta has had sand brought from the beach for Jaime and gives it to him. Jaime recalls a story that Marta once wrote for him. As Marta tries to write that story again, Fina comes to her room, and they talk about Jaime.
